title: narRaters
description: Open-source pipeline and web UI for processing narrative recall data. Raw audio or text recalls run through six steps (transcription, story event segmentation, spell/grammar correction, clause parsing, recall-to-event matching, and causal rating), with human review and editing at each stage.
